project_context.archetype: Futuristic space console (TRON-style) mixed with glassmorphism modules
project_context.vibe: Very dark petrol blue background, thin glowing teal/mint lines, high contrast, minimal ornament, no visual overload

rules: DM Mono is reserved for labels, statuses, tickers, prices and small technical text.
Mono text is uppercase with wide tracking (0.14em-0.18em) and small sizes (9px-12px).
Manrope stays reserved for titles, paragraphs and button labels.
High contrast: primary text near-white, never grey on grey.

background.note: body carries a fixed layered gradient (deep blue -> teal/green -> petrol) plus a faint grid; the app container must stay transparent so it shows through.

brand.legacy_alias: brand-green === brand-teal (kept so existing class names keep working)

usage_rules.teal_mint: primary actions, active states, positive/UP values, key metrics
usage_rules.gold: RESERVED for rewards and special states (prizes, claims, SIM/offline mode) — never as a generic accent
usage_rules.danger: negative values, expired timers, destructive confirms

text.note: Tailwind `white`/`black` are remapped to #e9fffb / #06131a, so text-white/40 etc. stay consistent.

layout_and_spacing.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative pb-28 text-white overflow-x-hidden
layout_and_spacing.radii: cards rounded-3xl (1.5rem) / rounded-console (1.75rem); pills rounded-full; inputs rounded-2xl

surface_strategies.console_module: .glass-card -> bg-app-surface/55, 1px rgba(233,255,251,0.07) border, rounded-3xl, inner light ring (inset 1px rgba(233,255,251,0.05)) + deep drop shadow. Reads as a dark blue glass module.
surface_strategies.ambient_orbs: .orb .orb-teal|.orb-blue|.orb-gold — blurred diffuse circles fixed behind the app (PageContainer), pointer-events:none, aria-hidden
surface_strategies.bottom_nav: floating dock: mx-3 mb-3 rounded-console bg-app-surface/75 backdrop-blur-2xl border-white/[0.09] shadow-console; active tab = teal pill + glow + 2px underline

chip.base: .chip -> pill, 9px mono uppercase, tracking 0.14em, rgba fill + 12% border

glows.rule: glow only on critical metrics/buttons — never on body content

hold_to_earn_button.wrapper: relative flex items-center justify-center w-64 h-64 mx-auto my-8
hold_to_earn_button.button: w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0b2430] to-[#041016] border border-brand-teal/30 shadow-glow-teal
hold_to_earn_button.progress_ring: absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-4 border-transparent border-t-brand-mint animate-spin
hold_to_earn_button.interaction: framer-motion whileTap={{ scale: 0.92 }} — must feel weighty. 3s hold, 3 holds per 8h cycle, then claim. LOGIC IS FROZEN.

reward.prize_popup: gold gradient text + gold glow, mono uppercase caption
reward.claim_reward: gold amount, soft-blue TonConnect CTA (TonConnect blue is allowed as an external-protocol exception)

components.primary_cta: w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-brand-teal text-black font-bold shadow-glow-teal hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95
components.secondary_cta: w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/[0.06] border border-white/[0.09] text-white font-semibold hover:bg-white/[0.1] active:scale-95
components.chart: UP #57d6c8 / DOWN #ff6b7a; grid lines rgba(233,255,251,0.06); axis labels DM Mono 10px; TP/SL dashed lines in mint/coral

icons_and_media.no_photos: The console look needs no photographic textures; depth comes from the ambient gradient, orbs and glass modules.

testing_attributes.rule: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='hold-button', data-testid='holds-remaining', data-testid='nav-trade', data-testid='pair-selector-trigger', data-testid='trade-buy-submit', data-testid='withdraw-submit', data-testid='copy-memo-btn'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Fonts are imported in frontend/src/index.css: Manrope (sans/display) + DM Mono (mono). Configure tailwind fontFamily accordingly.
Never re-introduce hardcoded hex colors in components — use the brand-* / app-* / ink tokens.
The Telegram WebApp chrome is themed in src/services/api.js (setHeaderColor / setBackgroundColor = #06131a) — keep it in sync with --background.
Since it's a Telegram Mini App, lock the layout to a mobile width container (max-w-md mx-auto).
Implement 5 tabs: Home, Missions, TRADE, Invite, Wallet (History is a section inside Wallet, not a tab).

Do not touch the hold/claim mechanics while restyling: 3s hold, 3 holds per 8h cycle, claim via TonConnect to the project wallet. Guards: frontend/src/__tests__/hold.test.jsx (4) + trade.test.jsx (21).
Use standard React .jsx syntax, no TypeScript.
Do not use generic UI cards — use the console_module surface strategy.
Verify with: cd frontend && npx vitest run (25 tests) && npx vite build; worker: cd cloudflare-worker && node --test tests/lib.test.mjs tests/trade.test.mjs (51 tests).
